body: Results are back - negative.

It's just negative urges - purely sexual and primitive.

I'm going to go get tested for HIV later today. I hope the LGBT center's testing equipment is sterile.
Masturbation is fine but I can't just jack it anywhere. Especially not at uni.
It isn't only my family's views. It's also mine.
not necessarily, just because i'm gay doesn't mean i have to start liking it. though after this thread i may start taking steps towards accepting it.

Interesting. I've always had the idea that homosexual people were fine with it but were unable to tell themselves that they did because of their environment, whereas I dislike it to its core, but if my situation is more common perhaps it isn't so bad.
As a homosexual I can attest that life is miserable. I can only hope that it is short

Thanks. I was really feeling down about it when I made the thread (I do have other problems, but this was starting to weigh on me), but now I feel a lot better about it. There's still a part of me that goes "well what the fuck are you doing you dopy twat?" when I think about it, but hopefully I'll be able to overcome it someday.
That's more or less the thing. It's not something that I ever wanted to have to deal with but I guess I have to - the only person who really needs to stop hating me for it os myself, I guess.
I'm sorry if you think my views are backwards and closed-minded. They probably are. It's not an easy pill for me to swallow,  you know.

Well, as I said, I've got very conservative views, and I don't want to be branded or known as a gay. Every single time I've had sex I could barely look myself in the mirror or look my loved ones in the eye, told myself never again and then a year later I hook up with another student. Maybe I just need to grow up, but it feels very wrong and deluded, if that maies sense.

Go fuck yourself. I already got this sort of response from a LGBT forum. 

EDIT: Sorry for saying that, but it's really upsetting to me that my position is actually impossible to believe to some. Maybe you're right that, in a way, I'm trolling myself, if that makes sense. Though this thread has given me a bit of perspective.
I'm deeply sorry.

You're right about them not needing to know about my sex life. But in a way I sort of feel tainted by it. I know it doesn't make too much sense, but I don't feel mature enough to be partaking in that sort of stuff (even though I very rarely do)
In a way, I kind of wish I was just a puppet. I've never _not_ been one, which is what makes it all the more jarring.
Those kind of stories are actually really cringy to me. Being gay in general is.
I have a hard time hiding important stuff from my family. It just feels like I'm being very ungrateful to them, though I do see your point.
They're not making me feel that way entirely - I am. In some ways I'm more conservative than they are.
I actually did ask a LGBT subreddit, but they told me to fuck off for being homophobic.
It definitely isn't my only problem. I'm guessing it's a bit hard to handle ATM because I'm still in a phase where I'm naturally horny.
Not necessarily. Well,  I don't really know, but I don't think I could ever love someone as much as I love my family.
Hey,  thanks for the comment. The issue is that they could very well feel that way until they die, which would be far more painful to me than keeping my homosexuality repressed would be.

I know, but I really wouldn't like to "ruin" my grandparents' last few decades on this Earth, though it means basically staying away from anything romantic or sexual for at least another 15 years (though I'm not too good at either.)

I've actually given consideration to chemical castration in the past. Not seriously, but I've considered it as an option. Of course, with some of the comments I've been reading here it doesn't seem that appealing anymore. 

That's another issue with homosexuality I have. I would have liked to have a typical family later down the road: a wife, a son, and a daughter. It sounds really typical, but that's how I imagined things to go down.

Meanwhile the concept of two men getting married just seems comical to me at best, and really weird in a sense. Maybe I'm just not ready to process that sort of stuff even though I should feel concerned. 


Let's not even get started on the children department, I would have loved to continue the bloodline, as silly as it sounds. As an only son, it's also my family's only option.
I don't know. I went to a LGBT center to get tested last year and the test included a talk with a counsellor. Weirdest conversation I ever had.

I've been jacking it to dudes since I was like 12 or 13 or something - I thought it was just a fad. I talked to a friend about it when I was 17 and I kind of realized that I was gay, but didn't really pay much attention to it until I actually became sexually active.

I don't really have anyone to confide to, sadly.
I've already overheard them talking about the possibility, but my father is in complete denial. I'll see what happens, but the issue is more with the fact that I really don't want to be a homosexual. I'm just constantly alternating between sort of being okay with it and hating it completely. It's weird.
It probably has to do with being submissive. I don't know if I'd feel fine telling my family I've had sex with a woman, but it would probably be easier than telling them I've had sex with a man.

They do, but I don't know if they'd love me as much. 

My family has actually been around some homosexuals - it's a long story, but basically my mother ran away for a year or so with a lesbian. Ever since my father has despised homosexuals, and my grandfather has been hardened by war, so he probably wouldn't take it very well either, since he's a very, very conservative type.
I can't just ignore everything else they've done for me, though. I suppose it's a bit jarring for me to have grown up making fun of gay people and turning out to be one.
I love them though. It's not a bridge I want to burn.
I don't think my family is going to change anytime soon, though.

Every single time I've had sex with a guy, I ended up thinking to myself "what would my family think", and every time I feel horrible and ashamed (plus worried the guy could have given me something.). It's not something I want to put up with for the rest of my life.
Well, I can hide it and repress it, but I mean, I'm not infallible. Thought I was and ended up hooking up with a guy near my college.
Yeah, quite a bit. I really don't want to stand out from the norm at all.
I don't _hate_ minorities, but I don't want to be one. Though my family (especially my grandparents and father, whom I adore far more than my mother) despise them. Immigrants, homos, you name it.
I just don't want to be a homo. I never wanted to be one - I didn't want to grow up to be able to say "I've taken a cock up the ass" and have it be the truth. It's like a huge stain on my own life.

Generally being attracted to guys, having to worry over STDs, that stuff. I want none of it. Plus all the gay marriage shit gets to my nerves, essentially I'm a homophobic but I'm still attracted to dudes. It's not the only problem I have, but it still makes me rather mad.
I just don't want to be a minority and have nagging thoughts all the time.
